Test a selective softmax weighting to see if it improves over inverse_error, given strong trend dominance and stable ranking.
test a deterministic bias adjustment (dba) which may capture trend dominance better than softmax weighting.
The series is trend dominated with stable ranking; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outlier models in the pool.
The series is trend dominated with stable ranking, so a non‑selective robust method like median may outperform selective weighting due to outlier models.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0487. Series context: trend strength 0.9995 and seasonal strength 0.0802; model ranking is stable across windows (Kendall tau 0.727); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 78.378.
